operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case identifiers: tables 'publication','book' lower; columns 'Publication_ID','Book_ID','Title' etc. must be double-quoted with original case.
Tiny DB: publication 7 rows, book 10 rows; no huge-table sampling needed.
Publication_Date declared TEXT, storage text, values like 'August 2008','March 2008' (month-name + year, no day).
Price REAL with huge magnitudes (15000000.0, 6000000.0) — real storage, not int.
Issues REAL but integral values (6.0,4.0,12.0) — real storage class.
FK publication.Book_ID -> book.Book_ID, parent exists, parent PK unique; 7 distinct child values over 10 parents.
All columns notnull=0 (nullable) though null_rate=0.0 in original; PKs declared but not NOT NULL.
No composite keys, no self-references, no dangling FKs, no views/triggers/indexes in DDL.
Book_ID appears in both tables (PK in book, FK in publication) — same name, different roles.
Title has near-duplicate strings ('Bloody Mary' vs 'Bloody Mary : Lady Liberty') — substring/prefix ties.
Publication_Date is text-stored date; TS dispatches TEXT -> String fuzzer, NOT Date fuzzer (no 'date' in type string).
Price/Issues REAL -> Number fuzzer with scale from type args (none) => default scale, full-range draws.
operator_ts_expectations: Publication_Date: String fuzzer (declared TEXT), so random charset strings + contaminate, NOT month-year format — likely FN on date predicates and FP on format checks.
Publisher/Writer/Title: String fuzzer, random a-zA-Z0-9() strings length 0-20 plus contamination; implausible names drive FN on equality/IN gold.
Book_ID/Publication_ID: Number fuzzer int, full range [-10^scale,10^scale] plus +-1/+-2 perturbation; PK uniqueness filtering keeps first occurrence, so many rows dropped.
Price/Issues: Number fuzzer float, huge uniform range plus +-0.01/+-0.02; original magnitudes (millions) unlikely reproduced -> FN on price/issue thresholds.
FK publication.Book_ID draws from book.Book_ID final values with replacement; since book PK filtered, child values are a subset — referential integrity holds but ties/duplicates in child likely.
Small tables: choose_table_sizes gives ~30-230 rows, far above originals (7/10) — cardinality-sensitive gold (COUNT, DISTINCT) will miss.
String fuzzer adds str(i+1)/str(i-1) for int-like elements; Publisher/Writer not int-like so no numeric variants.
Date fuzzer not used here (no 'date'/'timestamp' in declared types) — text dates get no format template, a known TS miss source.
Number list_max quirk (overwrite with full-range max) means even with elements the fresh draws dominate -> implausible Price/Issues.
p=0.2 default, whole-instance p=0 w.p. 0.3: some instances copy elements only, others mostly fresh — variance in plausibility.
max_l0 cap (rng*30) on non-PK columns limits fresh draws, so repeated values appear -> possible FP on DISTINCT/COUNT gold.
No CHECK/UNIQUE constraints beyond PK, so insert failures rare; rows_ok ~ requested size.
